question: Which of the following is a dormant volcano?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mauna Kea in Hawaii**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mauna Kea in Hawaii** is classified as a dormant volcano.
 
• Dormant volcanoes are those that have not erupted in a long time but have the potential to erupt in the future.
 
• Mauna Kea last erupted around 4,500 years ago.
 
• It is the highest point in Hawaii and is considered sacred by native Hawaiians.
 
• Unlike active volcanoes, dormant volcanoes do not show signs of imminent eruption.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mt. Erebus in Antarctica** is an active volcano and is known for its persistent lava lake.
 
• **Sakurajima in Japan** is one of the most active volcanoes in the world.
 
• **Etna in Italy** is also an active volcano and is one of the most active in Europe.
 
• Understanding the status of volcanoes is important for disaster preparedness and risk mitigation.
